customManagers.description: Every version Renovate cannot find by itself carries a `# renovate:` line directly above it: Talos and Kubernetes in talos/talenv.yaml, the bootstrap charts and Headscale in infra/, OpenTofu, age and etcd in the workflows, hcloud-upload-image in scripts/build-talos-snapshot.sh. One manager reads them all, so a version without the line is the only way to freeze silently.

packageRules.description: A Talos or Kubernetes bump changes the machine configs OpenTofu applies, but the nodes only move with a rolling upgrade. Approve it on the dashboard when the upgrade is planned.
The Flux operator and the Flux instance chart are released together and must move together.
A Cilium minor or major release changes the network every pod depends on. Approve it on the dashboard and apply it in a maintenance window.
Headscale is installed once by cloud-init, which ignores later changes; a bump records the version and its checksum must be updated with it. Upgrade the server by hand from the release notes.
prBodyNotes: Update `headscale_sha256` in `infra/headscale.tf` from the release's `checksums.txt`, then upgrade the running server by hand.

packageRules.description: age is installed from a pinned checksum, which Renovate cannot update. Approve on the dashboard and update the checksum in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Update `AGE_SHA256` in `.forgejo/workflows/etcd-backup-check.yml` to the sha256 of the new `linux-amd64` archive.

packageRules.description: The restore check uses the etcd release the cluster runs, which Talos chooses. Move it when a Talos upgrade moves etcd, not before.
hcloud-upload-image is installed from pinned checksums, which Renovate cannot update. Approve on the dashboard and update the checksums in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Update the three `upload_tool_sha256_*` values in `scripts/build-talos-snapshot.sh` from the release's `hcloud-upload-image_<version>_checksums.txt`.

packageRules.description: required_version constrains OpenTofu, which Renovate would otherwise look up as Terraform. OpenTofu's version is tracked through TOFU_VERSION in the workflow.
